Aisha / Marissa —

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed their redlines and sketched suggested language inline. Summary of positions I propose to send back to Skyline:

1) Publicity / Announcement (Section 12):
- Accept a one-time announcement with prior written approval. Add: "Customer may issue one (1) press release referencing Vendor provided that Customer provides Vendor with a draft and any quoted material at least three (3) business days prior to publication for approval, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed."

2) Logo Use:
- Approve use of Redwood logo per Skyline's guidelines subject to: (a) adherence to Skyline-Logo-Guidelines.pdf; (b) a single-line caption: "Redwood Inference — Technology Partner"; and (c) no implication of endorsement beyond the scope of the Order Form.

3) Reference / Testimonial Language in Order Form:
- Limit to a narrow permission for listing Redwood as a vendor and using a short description of the integration. No testimonial or star-rating language without separate written consent.

4) Confidentiality carve-out concerns:
- Recommend revising the carve-out to ensure it doesn't permit disclosure of Redwood's nonpublic performance metrics or KV cache info; propose an explicit exclusion for technical telemetry and customer usage detail.

I attached a clean markup (attached to this thread) and a short summary to include with the response. If Sales wants to soften any of the wording on approvals, let me know.

Thanks,
